init_data_loader: create a data loader for imagenet or cifar10 with supervised and unsupervised batch sampling
make_transforms: build image transforms for imagenet or cifar10 with color jitter, blur, and solarization augmentations
make_multicrop_transform: create a multicrop transform that returns multiple smaller augmented views of each image
class_stratified_sampler: build a batch sampler that samples images from randomly chosen classes with replacement
trans_imagenet_dataset: create a transimagenet dataset that returns multiple transformed views of each image per getitem call
